text.content:
The original Combat Zone, made into a home by the Valentinos.

Region: Heywood (district L). Was: the Old Combat Zone, the south of Old Japantown
Controlled by: The Valentinos, completely. The NCPD comes in when invited, or when the cameras are rolling
The feel of it: Funerals, food and a little justice; candles for the dead
Notable locations: Delamain HQ (#38), La Catrina (#39), Mercado Sonora (#40), Crisis Medical Center (#72), Jesse James' Deli (#73), Moto Cielo
Danger: Combat / Moderate. SC 3 (the Valentinos, de facto, Hardened Light). UC 7

The original Combat Zone and the ruins of Old Japantown, renamed when the Valentinos made it home. Edgerunners Inc. kept the peace here in 2045; they're long gone. Families from before the bomb and refugees from after it live in Mexican, Central and South American, Filipino, Black and Japanese neighborhoods, block by block. H5 towers over the market, the only megabuilding in a Combat Zone, with a decade-long waiting list. Stop Sign grew up here.

Recent History

  • 2047: The Purge sweeps start here, and the Purge-Riot burns the Old Combat Zone for four nights.
  • 2058: The bloodbath of Moto Cielo. The Valentinos walk out on top.
  • 2070: The war with 6th Street spills in from Arroyo. Valentino funerals every week.

Places

  • Delamain HQ (#38). SC 9. The only company with a Combat Zone contract the Valentinos honor.
  • Mercado Sonora (#40). SC 6. Food, clothes, guns and gossip under one roof; prices are fair, because the Valentinos check.
  • Crisis Medical Center (#72). SC 6. A hospital for people who can't afford one; the Valentinos pay for the night shift.
  • Jesse James' Deli (#73). SC 5. A kosher deli that has survived everything since 2030. Pastrami, gossip and a shotgun under the counter.

Getting There

NCART: Pajaro St, Mercado Sonora (Central Loop, Southern Line).

Turf

Valentinos.

People

  • "Don" Campo Orta (Ganger 9). Leader of the Valentinos.
  • Padre Ignacio (Fixer 7). The priest at La Catrina.
  • Lupe "Lady Luck" Torres (Ganger 6). Commands the war against 6th Street.
  • Dmitri Volkov (Tech 4). Fixes cars at the back of the Mercado and knows every Valentino ride by its engine.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.10
